title: Delayed Heuristic-Behavior-Target Coupling for Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning in Inventory Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.19917v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many reinforcement learning methods tie data collection to the task policy, while coordinating independently optimized behavior and target policies remains challenging. Policies learned by these methods can perform unreliably in long-horizon tasks under uncertainty, such as inventory control, where failures can incur extreme costs. We introduce Heuristic Behavior Policy Optimization (HBPO), an off-policy framework that routes heuristic guidance through persistent behavior learning, coupled with target-policy, updating separately with residual-based advantage estimation and emphatic weighting. Under matched environment interaction budgets on DSIS and its risk-augmented variant DSIS-RB, HBPO recovers many high-cost initial policies and improves most non-collapse comparison groups. Cold starts achieve competitive costs without final cost collapse across all tested seeds. We identify a transmission chain in the delayed heuristic-behavior-tar

translated_title: 库存控制中离策略强化学习的延迟启发式-行为-目标耦合方法
translated_abstract: 许多强化学习方法将数据收集与任务策略绑定在一起，而协调独立优化的行为策略与目标策略仍然具有挑战性。这些方法学到的策略在不确定性下的长时程任务中可能表现不可靠，例如库存控制，此类任务中的失败可能导致极端成本。我们提出了启发式行为策略优化（HBPO），这是一种离策略框架，通过持续的行为学习来引导启发式指导，并将其与目标策略耦合，采用基于残差的优势估计和强调加权进行分别更新。在DSIS及其风险增强变体DSIS-RB上，在匹配的环境交互预算下，HBPO恢复了许多高成本的初始策略，并改善了大多数未崩溃的对比组。冷启动在所有测试种子中均实现了具有竞争力的成本，且未出现最终成本崩溃。我们识别出延迟启发式-行为-目标（此处摘要原文被截断）……中的传递链。
tldr: 提出HBPO离策略强化学习框架，通过延迟的启发式-行为-目标耦合机制，在库存控制等长时程不确定任务中恢复高成本初始策略、提升成本竞争力并避免成本崩溃。
en_tdlr: HBPO is an off-policy reinforcement learning framework with delayed heuristic-behavior-target coupling that recovers high-cost initial policies and achieves competitive, collapse-free costs in long-horizon inventory control tasks.
